remarks: Stylish and Affordable light-filled Studio opposite Norwalk Hospital  This well-appointed studio apartment offers a perfect blend of style, comfort, and convenience in a prime Norwalk location directly opposite Norwalk Hospital.  The residence features an open-plan living, dining, and sleeping area complemented by a galley-style kitchen with cabinetry and workspace. A separate bathroom includes a full-size tub with an overhead shower.  Additional highlights include: Abundant natural light throughout the apartment, Generous off-street parking for residents, Laundromat within easy walking distance.  Nearby amenities including shops, cafes, and public transport options.  This property presents an ideal opportunity for a professional seeking a low-maintenance residence or an elegant pied-a-terre in a convenient setting: Schedule your tour today!
